what: Public-domain files held in this repository because their museum server sends no Access-Control-Allow-Origin, which stops the browser letting the paint read their pixels.
rights: Every file below was confirmed share_license_status CC0 through the museum API at fetch time.
derivation: Fetched from source_url, scaled so the long side is at most 1024px (Lanczos; left alone when already smaller), re-encoded JPEG quality 82, progressive, optimized.
source_sha256: The sha256 of the museum file as measured by the painting reader, where a reading for that work exists. The held file is a derivative and hashes differently.
